verdict.rationale: Subscription-lifecycle webhooks are a fair question for an invoicing product that offers recurring invoices and stored-card auto-charging, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no registrable webhooks or events for renewal, upgrade, payment failure or cancellation. The REST API and recurring-invoice features are building blocks, not outbound event callbacks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, every subscription state change — renewal, upgrade, payment failure, cancellation — emits a webhook or event my systems can act on reliably
